basic_info.description: Prime Noe Valley! This spectacular top full-floor, one-of-a-kind bay view, remodeled penthouse condo with private 2-car garage, walkout deck & beautifully private landscaped garden, is light-filled, surrounded by beautiful views & is truly a knockout! Upon entering one feels a sense of peacefulness with a dramatic welcoming view gallery foyer, bay view living & dining area, modern open floor plan, multiple bay windows, skylights, hdwd floors, moldings, state-of-the-art eat-in kitchen, 3 bdrms, 2 remodeled baths, lush media rm, In-unit laundry rm, & huge storage rm. Built in 1925, this gorgeous, stately, pristine, pride of ownership corner building with 4 condos is located in one of the city's most vibrant locations! In the heart of sunny Noe Valley, this superior building is walking distance to all the wonderful amenities this fabulous neighborhood has to offer, including shops & restaurants, the 24th Street shopping corridor. Close to fine schools, parks & transportation.
